description: The plot illustrates how BPC changes over training for an “XMoE Validating” curve and a second curve shown in magenta, both plotted against training progress. The x-axis is labeled “Training Steps” with a linear scale, spanning approximately 0 to 50 with major ticks at 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, and 50, and it includes a “(×10³)” multiplier indicating steps are in thousands. The y-axis is labeled “BPC” on a linear scale, ranging from about 1.10 up to about 2.25, with labeled ticks at 1.25, 1.50, 1.75, 2.00, and 2.25. The yellow line (solid) with small left-pointing triangle markers starts near 2.23 at 0k steps, drops steeply to around 1.55 by about 2k, then declines more gradually to roughly 1.30 by about 10k, reaches about 1.23 around 20k, and continues a slow decrease to about 1.15–1.16 by roughly 50k, with minor fluctuations after ~20k. The magenta line (solid) with small circular markers follows a similar trajectory, beginning near 2.23 at 0k, falling to about 1.55 by ~2k, decreasing to around 1.29–1.30 by ~10k, reaching roughly 1.20 around 20k, and then tapering to about 1.13–1.14 by ~50k, also showing small oscillations in the later steps.
